title: 2025's brightest stars: A holiday customer story round-up
summary: Unwrap 2025’s top stories! See how Unity drove innovation in automotive, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, and more in our holiday year-end customer story review.
body_markdown:
Beyond specific industries, Unity is providing the foundation for the next generation of digital experiences, including smart cities and interconnected virtual worlds. These ambitious projects require a platform that can handle massive datasets and deliver real-time performance, and our customers rose to the challenge in 2025.


We saw incredible progress in building dynamic smart digital twins. These projects use real-world data to create immersive simulations, helping planners model traffic, analyze environmental impact, and design more connected facilities. The collaboration between[ArcGIS and Unity](https://unity.com/resources/port-corpus-christi) empowered The Port of Corpus Christi and The Acceleration Agency to create a rich, geographically accurate digital twin, blending real-world data with creative vision.


[ROUVY](https://unity.com/resources/rouvy-indoor-cycling-XR) revolutionized indoor cycling by blending real video footage, 3D data, and live sensor input into ultra-realistic augmented reality routes using Unity. With features like the ROUVY Route Creator, users can transform their own footage and GPS data into rideable AR experiences, adding 20 TB of new content weekly. Map design and visualization workflows are the focus for[TomTom](https://unity.com/resources/from-gis-to-gpu-real-time-rendering-for-real-world-navigation) , who use Unity to create simulated environments that combine automotive navigation software in virtual worlds.


Redefining navigation with its Immersive View for Android XR,[Google Maps](https://unity.com/resources/google-maps) created a means for users to explore cities, landmarks, and venues in stunning 3D detail. Powered by Unity, this groundbreaking application seamlessly transitions from 2D maps to fully immersive experiences, offering unparalleled confidence in trip planning and discovery.


Dive into more customer stories about[immersive applications](https://unity.com/resources?topics=immersive-applications) .
